summary: TEA-99 Scene Composer fully verified via Playwright on /admin/studio (PIN 2580). All acceptance criteria from the ticket pass: tab renders between Scenes and NPCs, asset picker lists seeded assets, search filter works, empty-canvas placeholder shows, clicking assets adds layers with the newest selected, scale slider and +/- buttons work (clamped to [0.3, 2.5]), drag via low-level mouse moves layer left/top, remove and clear behave correctly, clicking canvas background deselects, layers do NOT persist across tab switch, and no composer keys land in localStorage. Implementation is fully self-contained inside ContentStudio.tsx (no new files).
critical_code_review_comments: ContentStudio.tsx is now 1712 lines — already very large for a single file. TEA-99 explicitly required the feature to live inline, so this is acceptable for the ticket, but the file is past the 700-line guideline and is a strong candidate for splitting per-tab in a follow-up.

SceneComposerTab is purely component-local state (no zustand store, no localStorage) which exactly matches the 'no persistence' requirement. Verified empty localStorage after composer usage and across tab switches.
Pointer capture is correctly wrapped in try/catch (good defensive code). Drag math uses getBoundingClientRect each pointermove, fine for an 8-layer canvas.

Drag clamps to [0, CANVAS_W] x [0, CANVAS_H] using the layer center; with scale=2.5 the layer can extend past the visible canvas edge because clamping is on center, not bounding box. Not a bug per the ticket (ticket only requires 'stays inside the 720x480 canvas' which is interpreted as the anchor point), but worth noting.

Tab strip overflows horizontally at 1440 viewport because 14 tabs no longer fit — the trailing 'Publish Queue' / 'Events' / 'NPCs' tabs require horizontal scroll. Pre-existing pattern (overflow-x-auto already in place), but adding Scene Composer makes it tighter.
test_credentials: Studio PIN: 2580 (from review request; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not consulted as composer requires no auth beyond PIN)
seed_data_creation: None — used the existing seeded studio assets (8 items detected, of which 7 visible asset cards in the picker after de-duplicating the search input that shares the data-testid prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Composer tested end-to-end. Important caveats for any retest: (1) React range inputs do NOT respond to el.value = ... — must use Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set then dispatch 'input' event, otherwise scale value will stay 1.00× while internal React state is unchanged. (2) Layer drag uses pointer events; page.mouse.down/move/up works fine, but you must start the mouse at the layer center because of translate(-50%,-50%) anchoring. (3) Composer layers reset on tab switch — this is correct behavior per ticket, do not flag as a bug.
